display_name: 源变化可靠度加权的响应保持恢复器，从零单阶段 30 轮
description: 保留原响应恢复器与 dense 后验，利用源模拟 Action/噪声代理连续降低低可观察性扰动的响应损失权重。

data.representation: Original R07 L_s6300/U_s56700 clean/received and recorded source simulator Action/noise; original global/other-RX priors and fixed1%-RMS four source directions.
data.actual_training_labels: Zero TX labels. Physical Action/noise source supervision, IQ/STFT and original frozen F0 continuous features; weighted source response uses source simulator Action and scalar variance only.
data.augmentation: Original one of four fixed source IQ directions per record/epoch; recorded simulator Action creates paired received perturbation with same noise.

permissions.query_use: Source RX selects training prior/mode factor only. Deployed G consumes current IQ and its fixed source buffers. No V/OE/target fit or TX truth.
permissions.claim_scope: Source reliability weight modifies response objective only; true source Action/noise never enter deployment. No target training, source TX labels, V/OE fitting, F0 logits/CE or new identity head.

checkpoint.initialization: All1471463 G parameters scratch, same E0 as ResponseDense. No prior model or optimizer loaded.
sources: FROZEN_F0 original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source checkpoint and legal original source moments.

checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Scratch G with source-only F0 continuous feature guidance and source simulator traces. No TX/V/OE/target training.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final30/7410 only; all seven views of both Main populations predicted before truth-last. Matched control comparison only after both entire matrices fixed.

rows.purpose: Test whether a source noise/action reliability proxy improves response-preserving training without amplifying every weak synthetic direction.
